import numpy as np


def forecast(train_series, history_windows, feature_cols, target_col, input_len, output_len):
    t = feature_cols.index(target_col)
    # Use recent power levels (last 24 steps) and map wind speed to power curve
    w = feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    recent_power = np.mean(history_windows[:, -24:, t], axis=1)
    avg_wspd = np.mean(history_windows[:, -48:, w], axis=1)
    bins = np.linspace(0, 20, 20)
    curve = train_series.groupby(np.digitize(train_series["Wspd"], bins))[target_col].mean()
    target_val = np.array([curve.get(i, train_series[target_col].mean()) for i in np.digitize(avg_wspd, bins)])
    
    # Blend target with global mean to increase stability for long horizons
    final_target = 0.7 * target_val + 0.3 * train_series[target_col].mean()
    
    # Use exponential decay toward the combined target
    decay = 0.985 ** np.arange(output_len)
    preds = recent_power[:, None] * decay + final_target[:, None] * (1 - decay)
    return np.clip(preds, 0.0, None)
